confirmation_wording.addon_offer_template: I found your usual order for ₹{baseline_total} ({baseline_summary}). I also found {addon_name} for ₹{addon_price}, which is {addon_reason}. Total would be ₹{projected_total}, still under your ₹{budget} budget. Want me to add it?
confirmation_wording.payment_confirm_template: Ready to pay ₹{total} for: {line_summary}. Confirm payment?

acceptance_criteria: No Razorpay call before explicit payment confirmation of exact proposal_id + total
Recommendations are optional and explained; never silent upsell
Final proposal total never exceeds stated budget or hard ceiling
Every skip/trim/substitution/recommendation has a one-line reason
Audit trail covers money-related decisions with secrets redacted
Metrics distinguish projected vs realized uplift
Payment failure: one retry then clear failure message
